dog.description_text:
Bobbi is so sweet and loves to be pet and snuggle up next to us. He likes playing with toys and is very curious. Bobbi gets along with our small dog Otto!
Bobbi is already house trained! He lets us know when he needs to go out. He’s got short, soft fur and is low shed. He sleeps through the night with no issues!

Bobbi is medium energy! He doesn’t bark inside but can be vocal when playing or out of affection.
Bobbi is getting used to walking in NYC; he walks pretty well but barks at loud noises, big trucks, and other dogs. This little guy loves his food and treats. Bobbi’s favorite thing is to be pet and cuddled. He’s learned his name so quickly and understands “no”. We will start trying other commands! We have no doubt that he will pick up on new tricks. He’s a very smart dog who wants to listen and tries to understand what we want from him. Most importantly, he is so loving and wants to be loved!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
dog.name: Bobbin (Bobbi)
